## 맵 아이콘 인터그래이션
### 0.1.3 Change Log
#### Global
##### Fixed
* Fixed stale NPC edits overwriting newer settings when saving map profiles.
##### Improved
* Improved NPC synchronization for players sharing the same dimension.
* Improved image caching and JourneyMap updates for unchanged icons.
#### Forge 1.20.1 / Fabric & NeoForge 1.21.1
##### Fixed
* Fixed JourneyMap icons disappearing after replacing textures under the same resource ID.
#### Forge 1.20.1
##### Fixed
* Fixed DNPC map icons remaining hidden on Forge.
* Fixed unrestricted DRM dependencies being rejected on Forge.

0.1.3 Change Log

Global

Fixed
  • Fixed stale NPC edits overwriting newer settings when saving map profiles.
Improved
  • Improved NPC synchronization for players sharing the same dimension.
  • Improved image caching and JourneyMap updates for unchanged icons.

Forge 1.20.1 / Fabric & NeoForge 1.21.1

Fixed
  • Fixed JourneyMap icons disappearing after replacing textures under the same resource ID.

Forge 1.20.1

Fixed
  • Fixed DNPC map icons remaining hidden on Forge.
  • Fixed unrestricted DRM dependencies being rejected on Forge.
